protocol: Frozen 300-image cohorts. YOLOE uses exactly the PET-DINO 1/5/10-shot supports, boxes and seed=0. GroundingDINO uses verbatim WeDetect Chinese prompts. Every class queries every image; class-labelled predictions are merged without cross-class NMS. Candidate floor=0.001, NMS IoU=0.7, maxDets=100/class, evaluation IoU=0.5 and score=0.5. Model-native preprocessing and feature aggregation are retained. Fresh inference; no training/API calls.
